mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 74 degrees. Also, tonight you can catch the International Space Station starting at 8:17 PM as it travels from the south southwest toward the east northeast, reaching about halfway up the sky.

In city updates, phase two of the Highway M construction project begins the week of September 7th, requiring traffic shifts and lane closures. Additionally, the city has officially installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park, a beautiful wooden piece by local artists.

It is a busy week for activities. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returns to Hometown Junction Park, and you can also find music at Paddy Mac's, trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, or even a yoga session at Insight Wellness.

The Verona Police Department reported that a 34-year-old Madison woman was arrested and booked on Friday, September 4th, on charges related to the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, stemming from information received by the school district on August 30th.
It is a great day to stop by Culver's for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. The restaurant is open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
